messages.text: @dferraro Sales question — can Columbus take on another cold-chain client (~15 pallets/day, 97% OTD)?
replies: Short answer: no, not right now. Reefer docks are the constraint and they're maxed. Adding a second strict cold-chain account would put both at risk.
Got it, thank you. Adding that to the deal review.

replies: How many of the misses are on us vs the carrier?
